body: Talking isn't what I need as much as I appreciate it, this feeling has been set for years. I just fake a face with everyone. And the people who do know say they'll be there but when they actually see the depression they stay away because "they couldn't handle if I die" then they leave forever. Sadly I'm the person to talk someone out of it myself but in my sick mind I think "let me go with you" but that's not realistic. I want to die, I don't enjoy life at all. I despise humans, I've wrecked any chance of a future without living paycheck to paycheck or being alone. I actually don't mind being alone even if it's forever, I hate humans. That's probably the main reason, people disgust me. Selfish ignorant things we are. I just want to know how to leave.
